name: ludustack-legacy-helper
description: Helper scripts for Ludustack legacy (no Node build).

scripts.cert:ensure: bash -c 'mkdir -p $HOME/.aspnet/https; if [ ! -f "$HOME/.aspnet/https/aspnetapp.pfx" ]; then openssl req -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout $HOME/.aspnet/https/dev.key -out $HOME/.aspnet/https/dev.crt -subj "/CN=localhost" -days 365 && openssl pkcs12 -export -out $HOME/.aspnet/https/aspnetapp.pfx -inkey $HOME/.aspnet/https/dev.key -in $HOME/.aspnet/https/dev.crt -passout pass:SECRETPASSWORD; fi'
scripts.db:import: bash -c 'DB=LUDUSTACK_DEV; URI="mongodb://localhost:27017/?replicaSet=rs0"; for f in ./db-backup/*.json; do coll="$(basename "$f" .json)"; coll="${coll#LUDUSTACK.}"; mongoimport --uri "$URI" --db "$DB" --collection "$coll" --file "$f" --jsonArray --drop; done'
scripts.docker:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.override.yml -p ludustack-legacy up -d
scripts.docker:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.override.yml -p ludustack-legacy down
scripts.dev: bash -c 'npm run db:up && ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development MongoSettings__Connection="mongodb://localhost:27017/?replicaSet=rs0" MongoSettings__DatabaseName="LUDUSTACK_DEV" dotnet run --project LuduStack.Web --no-launch-profile'
scripts.dev:curl: bash -c 'for i in {1..30}; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:54354/ || true); if [ "$code" = "200" ] || [ "$code" = "302" ]; then echo OK; exit 0; fi; sleep 1; done; echo FAIL; exit 1'
